claude-code-web.name: Claude Code on the web
claude-code-web.says: a per-environment setup script runs once before the harness starts; an install from the package index works under the default network level

codex-cloud.name: Codex cloud
codex-cloud.says: a setup script runs with internet access before the agent phase, which blocks internet access by default

github-copilot.name: GitHub Copilot
github-copilot.says: one job named copilot-setup-steps in that workflow file sets up the cloud agent's environment, and the file counts only on the default branch

cursor-cloud.name: Cursor
cursor-cloud.says: the install key of that file runs when the environment is built, from the default branch's copy
